data_fields.name: emptyGraceS
data_fields.donor_constant: 30 min (FinalEmperialTomb), 10 min (SanctumOfLilith), 0 in most; negative = never destroyed while empty

data_fields.name: warnAtS
data_fields.donor_constant: 300 s and 60 s before the end (5 min and 1 min)

data_fields.name: partyBitMaxFromConfig
data_fields.donor_constant: Config.Character.ALT_PARTY_MAX_MEMBERS (party size bound used by the group mask)

best_idea: An instance world is a small state machine (created, timed, empty-grace, destroyed) whose timers are zone data, with warnings at fixed checkpoints and a grace window before an empty zone is torn down.
decision_why: Keep the lifecycle and the five data timers (duration, empty grace, eject after death, warning checkpoints, max worlds), run them on the server as a tick-driven state machine, and fix donor defects D1 to D5 in the sketch. Reject the wall-clock ThreadPool timers and the unapplied ON_ENTER reenter lock (not in our rulings for now).
acceptance: Server test: a 120-second zone with warnings at 60 s and 30 s sends each warning once at its checkpoint, destroys at 120 s and ejects anyone still inside; a zone with a 10-second empty grace whose last player leaves at 30 s is destroyed at 40 s unless someone re-enters first.
